title: Backlot — Your AI Video Studio, In Your Pocket

music.note: No music supplied. Free local tools only, so no music generation API was used.

scenes.title: Title card
scenes.narration: Supplied voice track begins at 0:00. The audio file is a steady 220 Hz tone, not detectable speech; it is used as supplied instead of fabricating a voiceover or transcript.
scenes.visual_description: Branded title card: the supplied Backlot logo fills the background under a dark scrim, with the product name 'Backlot' and the line 'Your AI video studio, in your pocket' springing in.
overlays: Subtitle: Your AI video studio, in your pocket

scenes.title: Avatar intro
scenes.narration: Supplied voice track continues. No lip-sync or synthetic voice was generated; the uploaded avatar clip is used as-is.
scenes.visual_description: The uploaded avatar intro clip plays full-frame, upscaled from 640x360 to the 16:9 frame, introducing the presenter.
scenes.captions: Direct your studio from your phone.
scenes.audio: Uploaded narration track continues; avatar clip audio is muted by the renderer

scenes.title: Screen recording demo
scenes.narration: Supplied voice track continues to its 12-second end. The demo footage is the user's uploaded screen recording, not a fabricated capture.
scenes.visual_description: The uploaded 1280x720 screen recording plays full-frame as the product demo, showing the user's own captured footage.
overlays: No screen recording was fabricated or re-captured
scenes.audio: Uploaded narration track continues; screen recording has no audio

scenes.title: End card
scenes.narration: No narration. The uploaded voice track ends at 12.0s.
scenes.visual_description: Closing brand card: supplied logo background under a dark scrim with 'Backlot' and the call to action 'Create anywhere.'
